name: Mask of a Thousand Faces (Obfuscate, Intermediate, Dark Ages)

system.description:
You can take on the appearance of someone else — a forgettable everyman, a real individual, or a wholly imagined appearance. Your body does not change; those who see you perceive you according to your desires. You can automatically mute your features so no one recognizes you (or identifies your clan). If you expend a Mental Trait, you can take on any appearance you wish, and since the effect lies in the minds of witnesses, it fools all senses.

Mask of a Thousand Faces does not automatically augment your Social Traits; you can expend Blood Traits to increase your Social Traits one-for-one, though not beyond your generational limits.
